items.title: Earl Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: So I got Bobby Alsbin to sub for me and I went down to Los Angeles.

ctx.x: That’s interesting because he’s the first fella you recorded with, isn’t he?

Yes. In the Navy. And also in the mid-forties after the war Wilbert went to Los Angeles. See because he had lived there before and he knew all the musicians down there. They knew all the guys in the union. Curtis Mosby, you’ll see his name in the annals, big band annals, Wilbert had been on the road with him, oh back in I guess the early thirties. Anyhow Wilbert went to Los Angeles. And as I said not only was he a fine pianist but he was a fine arranger. So Wilbert, he got in down there. He was working, he had a…
